parameters.name: periods
parameters.description: Set of planning periods in the weekly horizon

parameters.name: num_periods
parameters.description: Number of periods in the planning horizon

parameters.name: num_products
parameters.description: Number of products in the planning problem

parameters.name: production_time_per_unit
parameters.description: Production time requirement per unit of each product

parameters.name: storage_space_per_unit
parameters.description: Storage space requirement per unit of each product

parameters.name: available_production_time
parameters.description: Available production time in each period

parameters.name: minimum_mix_requirements
parameters.description: Listed minimum proportional output requirements between ordered product pairs

parameters.name: direct_storage_caps
parameters.description: Direct storage capacity cap for products when provided

variables.name: production_quantity
variables.description: Quantity of product produced or sold for each product in each period

variables.name: total_profit
variables.description: Total profit achieved by the production plan

constraints.name: production_time_capacity
constraints.description: Total production time used in each period cannot exceed the available production time for that period.

constraints.name: minimum_mix_requirements
constraints.description: All specified minimum proportional output relationships between product pairs must be satisfied, including the rule that product B must be produced at least a fixed multiple of product A.

constraints.name: storage_capacity_limits
constraints.description: Storage usage must respect product-specific storage coefficients and any direct storage caps, including the direct upper bound on product A.

constraints.name: nonnegative_production_quantities
constraints.description: All production quantities must be nonnegative.

objectives.name: profit_maximization
objectives.description: maximize total profit from all sold output over all periods

final_objective.description: maximize total profit from all sold output over all periods
